description: Python service layer over SQLite with explicit versioned migrations and an existing users table

profile.PROJECT_NAME_AND_PURPOSE: accounts-core: user account storage for a customer-facing service
profile.PRIMARY_JOURNEYS: Create a user; look up a user; evolve the schema without losing data
profile.SCOPE: Included: user records and schema migrations. Excluded: authentication UI, email delivery
profile.TECHNOLOGY_STACK: Python 3.10+ standard library; SQLite via `sqlite3`; SQL migrations in `migrations/`
profile.SUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENTS: Linux x86_64 with Python 3.10+ and SQLite 3.35+
profile.DATA_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARIES: Customer personal data (confidential); production database holds live records; tests use in-memory databases only
profile.DEPLOYMENT_BOUNDARIES: Production at prod.example.invalid; deploys and production migrations only by the owner, per operation
